title: mris_ca_deform
description: Deforms a surface to match it to a volumetric map of cortical labels.

input_surface.description: The input surface file to be deformed.
input_surface.title: Input Surface

transform.description: The transform file, typically a matrix that aligns the volumes.
transform.title: Transform

intensity_vol.description: The intensity volume that is used in the deformation process.
intensity_vol.title: Intensity Volume

output_surface.description: The file name for the output, deformed surface.
output_surface.title: Output Surface
